_comment: Pinned public sources for every pack. Each is built from primary public sources by Fireplace's own corpus pipeline. dump_date + sha256 are filled when each pack is built (Phase 2).

wikipedia.notes: English Wikipedia; chunked to ~250-word passages, FTS5 + int8 dense index. May trim to top-N% by pageviews for disk/speed headroom.

places.notes: POIs with diet/opening-hours tags; structured so place questions can be answered in code.

travel.notes: Wikivoyage guides + per-country facts (emergency numbers, plugs, currency).

first-aid.notes: First-aid procedures; shown verbatim where safety-critical.

crypto.origin: EIPs/ERCs repo, consensus-specs, ethereum.org, NIST PQC
crypto.notes: Ethereum + post-quantum reference material (in the eval distribution).
